subject.title: fix(ai): add handshake timeout to ChatGPT Responses WebSocket connect

question: Should ChatGPT Responses use a 30-second default WebSocket handshake deadline for callers without an explicit request timeout, allowing auto transport to fall back to SSE after that deadline?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and tested, but selecting a new default deadline and fallback point changes existing provider behavior for slow or unusual network paths.

options.title: Adopt the 30-second default
options.body: Accept the proposed connection-phase deadline because it prevents indefinite hangs, respects explicit timeoutMs values, and follows existing 30-second WebSocket handshake conventions.

options.title: Choose a different policy
options.body: Request a different provider-specific deadline or an opt-in transport policy if 30 seconds is not acceptable for supported ChatGPT Responses network paths.

recommendation.title: Adopt the 30-second default
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed connection-phase deadline because it prevents indefinite hangs, respects explicit timeoutMs values, and follows existing 30-second WebSocket handshake conventions.
